method: Supabase management connector: list_projects plus read-only catalog SELECTs (pg_namespace, pg_class, pg_roles, pg_extension, pg_stat_user_tables, storage.buckets). No DDL, DML, role or storage change.
limits: A project name is not identity proof; the operator must confirm the mapping, environment and approved connection-secret references.
No direct database route (host/port/login) was exercised; the connector's own route is not the installer's route.
Row counts come from pg_stat_user_tables (estimates), not a consistent snapshot; they are inventory, not protected-data evidence.
collision_check: No mission_control, mission_control_search or mission_control_runtime schema and no mission_*/belllabs_* role exist; the legacy capability_search schema is populated and must remain untouched (not dropped, not migrated).
